title: Layouts, Model/Paper Space, Viewports, Plot Preview & Publishing: the bounded layout/plot subsystem
objective: Deliver the professional layout/plot/publishing subsystem on the frozen CAD/BIM Product Architecture v1.0 (Issue #88; the CAD-PARITY program's next subsystem after CAD-PARITY-007 merged at 5fbe2ed): explicit Model Space / Paper Space context with multiple named layouts (canonical monotonic lo-NNNNNN identities, activation/rename/create/clone/delete with reference-safe semantics — the clone/remove cascades are ONE atomic revision each), rectangular layout viewports (vp-NNNNNN identities; camera center/scale/rotation, the display-lock semantics, the deterministic model↔paper transform with rectangular clipping, per-viewport layer visibility overrides bounded to the existing layer model — the VPLAYER surface, deterministic frame selection + grip editing), page setup (the ISO paper table, orientation, margins/printable area, the plot-scale policy with the bounded layout-plot equivalence, plot origin/centering, the plot-style-table reference as an explicit document setting with the CTB/STB typed decline, the layer/border plot toggles), the deterministic plot preview (the shared Plot IR — the exact same semantic transforms the export path uses), deterministic publishing/export (the canonical engine-independent Sheet/Plot IR, the deterministic SVG writer and the minimal deterministic PDF writer with byte-identical repeated exports, typed plot_unsupported declines for proprietary formats/devices, no DWG plotting internals), the 14-command vocabulary (LAYOUT/LAYOUTNEW/LAYOUTRENAME/LAYOUTCLONE/LAYOUTDELETE/TILEMODE/MSPACE/PSPACE/MVIEW/VPORTS/PAGESETUP/PREVIEW/PLOT/PUBLISH), the professional Web + Electron surfaces (layout tabs distinct from the Model tab, the paper canvas with printable-area framing, the viewport lock-state visibility, the page-setup palette, the plot preview surface, the layouts manager) with shared Web/Electron semantics (LOCK-004), save/open/undo/redo/replay persistence with Construction Graph mapping by canonical identity (document-only tables — the constraint precedent), and Vercel deployed verification of the exact implementation head including the real layout workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic multi-layout model/paper-space workflow through the shared App API: one model-space view plus multiple named paper-space layouts (no silent content duplication — model geometry is REFERENCED through viewports, never copied), layout activation/rename/create/clone/delete with reference-safe semantics (the clone copies the layout AND its viewports with fresh document-minted identities in ONE revision; the remove cascades the viewports away with the record in ONE revision; the last remaining layout is a typed command decline — journal semantics keep undo of the first creation replayable).

At least two layouts containing independently scaled/locked viewports onto the same model: rectangular viewports with camera center, scale (model units per paper mm) and rotation through the ONE shared deterministic transform (paper = vpCenter + R(θ)·((model − camera)/denominator)), the display-lock gate (a locked view rejects camera/scale/rotation edits with the typed viewport_locked error — the frame still moves), rectangular clipping of the viewport content, and per-viewport layer visibility overrides composed with the layer-table plot/visibility filtering (frozen/unplottable layers stay excluded — regeneration-class rules).

Page setup persisted through save/open: paper size (the named ISO table with the canonical dimensions + CUSTOM), orientation, margins/printable area, the plot-scale policy (the bounded layout-plot equivalence: layouts plot at exact paper size; the N:M ratio is recorded as provenance), plot origin/centering, the plot-style-table reference (CTB/STB application is the typed decline), and the layer/border plot toggles — every field survives save/open byte-exactly.

Plot preview matches the canonical plot IR: the preview consumes the SAME Plot IR the export writers consume (per-viewport projected model geometry + annotations with resolved display, the frame furniture with the visual distinction between model geometry and the paper-space composition) — parity by construction, not by inspection.

Repeated export is byte-identical: the deterministic SVG writer (native clipPaths, fixed element order + number formatting) and the minimal deterministic PDF writer (vector bezier curves, standard-14 Helvetica with exact AFM widths, computed xref, multi-page PUBLISH) produce identical bytes for identical document state on every host, every run.

Web/Electron semantic stream and resulting output are identical: the SAME 41-command stream through the shared prompt engine produces the SAME document save sha256, the SAME command stream AND the SAME plot SVG/PDF artifact hashes on both hosts (the pinned CAD-PARITY-008 fixture asserted by the Web smoke AND the Electron real-UI smoke through CDP).

Existing pinned fixtures remain byte-identical: CAD-PARITY-002/004/005/006/007 stay byte-identical (the canonical-minimal snapshot contract — layouts/viewports are ABSENT while empty) and the deployed build reproduces ALL SIX fixtures.

Full application/regression suite remains green: 919 tests (871 pre-existing + 48 CAD-PARITY-008) with both real engines, the LOCK-018 scan over the extended workspace core, and the pre-existing host regressions.

Exact PR head is deployed to Vercel and the layout workflow is browser-verified there: the deployment bound to the exact implementation head (meta gitsha), the full 41-command fixture stream against the deployed build, and the real browser protocol (layout tabs, the painted paper canvas with viewport content, the plot preview overlay) with zero page errors.
Governance evidence is bound to exact commit/CI/deployment identities with real timestamps.
non_goals: Full CTB/STB parser/editor fidelity: the plot-style-table reference persists as an explicit document setting; applying proprietary CTB/STB plot styles at plot time is a TYPED decline (plot_unsupported) — the bounded slice plots as-displayed.
Device-specific printer drivers: no OS print spooling, no device paper sources — the output targets are the deterministic file exports (SVG/PDF/Plot IR).
DWG proprietary plot implementation: no AutoCAD plotting internals (an explicit Issue #88 non-goal); the plot_unsupported decline names the bound.
Complex non-rectangular viewport clipping (polygonal/circular viewports) — rectangular viewports only, the declared bounded limit.

Advanced batch-publish automation across arbitrary external project sets: PUBLISH batches the CURRENT document's layouts (all or an explicit subset) into one deterministic artifact; no external project traversal, no sheet nesting/imposition.

Per-viewport annotative scaling beyond the existing document-wide annotation behavior (annotation scale scales with the viewport through the model-space projection; no per-viewport annotative contexts).

Named page-setup TABLES: one embedded active page setup per layout (the named-table lifecycle is a later slice); paper-space ENTITY authoring (paper-space text/blocks/title blocks remain the documentation-sheet subsystem's domain).
Specialized raster/map/point-cloud plotting and plot-stamp/filename stamping.
risk_assumptions: ASSUMPTION (deployed verification reachability): the CAD-PARITY-008 deployment lives on the owner's existing Vercel project (the CAD-PARITY-007 deployment precedent), reachable from this sandbox for the fixture/browser protocols; the browser protocol runs through a local serialization relay because the in-memory CADDocument splits across serverless instances under concurrent requests (the documented CAD-PARITY-002-era hosting finding — a production-hosting constraint of the in-memory editor model, NOT a CAD-PARITY-008 defect).

ASSUMPTION (electron paper canvas scope): the Electron paper canvas is the display + tab + preview + panel-editing surface; viewport frame GRIP editing (corner resize/move) is the Web paper canvas affordance this slice (both hosts edit viewports through the SAME viewport.update commands — semantic parity holds; the host affordance difference is documented honestly).

RISK (credential boundary — OPEN): the sandbox reset wiped the GitHub token previous sessions received via chat ($GITHUB_TOKEN; verified exhaustively absent from every file/env/process on this machine). The implementation, the local gauntlet and the deployed verification are COMPLETE at the local head; the push, the PR, the CI runs on the head and the PR_OPEN transition are BLOCKED until the architect re-provides the token (the 007-session credential handoff precedent). The Vercel deployment of the exact head (dpl_44GnFDcx8ySzvS3cn4rMPRkpGrw1, meta gitsha e7e8ab2…) already exists and is verified; the CI-run evidence entries will bind to the pushed head's runs when the credential arrives.

ASSUMPTION (bounded plot policy): layouts plot at exact paper size (the AutoCAD layout-plot equivalence); the recorded N:M ratio governs model-space direct plotting, outside this slice — the honest bounded rule (an alternative interpretation — sheet scaling by M/N — was implemented first and corrected during the smoke runs when it produced an absurd 29.7 m output page for 1:50).
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated suites for the paper model (the ISO table, the page-setup grammar, the model↔paper transform with exact inverses/rotation/clipping/fit-window views, the model extents), the canonical Plot IR (per-viewport projected content, the layer plot/visibility filtering composed with viewport overrides, the plot policy, determinism) and the document model (lo-/vp-minting, the eight edit variants with exact inverses incl. key-adding updates, canonical-minimal snapshot/history with legacy byte-identity, replay integrity, reference-checked removal + the command-layer last-layout rule).

The App API/command surface: layout.create/rename/clone/remove/setPageSetup/activate/setSpace + viewport.create(fit|window|scale)/update/remove with the viewport_locked gate + plot.export/plot.publish with the plot_unsupported typed declines + the layouts.list/plot.preview queries, one atomic revision per mutating command, and the 14-command prompt-engine vocabulary.

The pinned CAD-PARITY-008 parity fixture asserted by BOTH hosts: the Web prompt-engine smoke AND the Electron real-UI smoke (CDP) must match the save sha256, the 41-command semantic stream AND the plot SVG/PDF artifact hashes — Web/Electron parity is the acceptance criterion (LOCK-004).
The exact PR head deployed to Vercel (meta gitsha binding) with the full fixture stream + the browser protocol (layout tabs, the painted paper canvas, the plot preview overlay) and zero page errors.
The existing CAD-PARITY-002/004/005/006/007 pinned fixtures stay byte-identical (locally AND against the deployed build).
